description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the UserDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It includes setup routines for test fixtures, utility methods for retrieving entities, and multiple test cases validating user DAO functionalities such as saving users, checking user existence, retrieving system users, and fetching user roles.

classes.name: UserDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the UserDao class methods within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture before each test, setting up UserDao instance and populating data from a fixture file.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole entity by ID from the database.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee entity by employee number from the database.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUser
methods.description: Tests the saveSystemUser method of UserDao by creating and saving a new User entity, then verifying persistence.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForNonExistingUser
methods.description: Validates that querying a non-existent user returns null.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForExistingUser
methods.description: Validates that querying an existing user returns a User instance.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForDeletedUser
methods.description: Verifies that a deleted user returns null when checked.

methods.name: testIsExistingSystemUserForEmptyPasswordUser
methods.description: Verifies that a user with an empty password returns null.

methods.name: testGetSystemUser
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a system user by ID.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserForNonExistingId
methods.description: Verifies that requesting a non-existent user ID returns null.

methods.name: testGetAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of assignable user roles, checking expected roles and count.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of system user IDs.

methods.name: testGetSystemUserIdListForOneActiveUser
methods.description: Tests filtering system user ID list after marking some users as deleted.

methods.name: testGetEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving employees by user role, with variations on including terminated employees.

methods.name: testUserStatusByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username exists in the system.
